findings.title: Exact durable query ownership is bypassable inside general backend roots.
findings.context: DATABASE_BOUNDARY allows packages/backend/src/ and packages/domain/src/. The durable rule selects only query-call. A non-adapter backend file can use namespace, dynamic, CommonJS, or re-export access. A raw postgres client can issue SELECT * FROM durable_jobs without a durable finding.

findings.suggestion: Preserve durable-rule detection for all database access forms, or add complete table-taint analysis. Narrow general database roots when required.
